description: Use when an agent needs one English brief on a token before trading or listing it. Input: token (base:0x… or sol:<mint>), format=json|markdown. Output: executiveSummary, riskAssessment (signals, owner/proxy or mint/freeze authority, holders), liquidity (price, depth, $1k/$10k buy impact), perpMarket (Hyperliquid, symbol match), sanctions (OFAC wallets), dataGaps. AI-written from chain facts; not advice. Example: ?token=base:0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631 Price: $0.20 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

format.description: markdown adds a readable English rendering of the same report

token.description: One token: base:0x… (ERC-20 on Base) or sol:<mint>. Unknown token or bad input → 400 before payment (not charged)
